title: Theft
description: Punishes moving any movable property out of the possession of any person without consent dishonestly. Covers theft in dwellings, transport, and by clerks.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or with fine, or both. For community service on petty theft (value under Rs 5,000 upon return).

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
description: Occurs when someone entrusted with property dishonestly misappropriates, converts it to their own use, or uses it in violation of legal direction.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both.

title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
description: Defines cheating where someone deceives another person to fraudulently deliver property, retain property, or consent to make or alter valuable security.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years for simple cheating, or up to 7 years with fine for cheating with delivery of property.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
description: Deals with intentionally causing bodily pain, disease, or infirmity to any person without justification or provocation.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both.

title: Assault and Criminal Force
description: Penalizes making any gesture or preparation intending or knowing it will cause apprehension of criminal force against another individual.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both.

title: Defamation
description: Making or publishing any imputation concerning any person with intention or knowledge that it will harm their reputation.
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both, or community service.

title: Information in Cognizable Cases (FIR Registration)
description: Mandates that every information relating to a cognizable offence given orally or electronically to police must be reduced to writing. Allows electronic filing (e-FIR) provided signature is given within 3 days.
punishment: Mandatory duty of police officer. Refusal to register cognizable complaint can lead to legal action against officer.

title: When Police May Arrest Without Warrant
description: Details conditions under which police can arrest without magistrate order. Requires reasons in writing for offences punishable with up to 7 years, prioritizing notice of appearance instead of automatic arrest.
punishment: Procedural safeguard against arbitrary police arrest.

title: Maximum Period of Detention for Undertrial Prisoners
description: Provides that first-time undertrial offenders who have spent one-third of the maximum sentence in detention shall be released on bond or bail by court.
punishment: Statutory right to bail for undertrial prisoners.

title: Direction for Grant of Bail to Person Apprehending Arrest (Anticipatory Bail)
description: Empowers High Court or Court of Session to grant anticipatory bail to any person who has reason to believe they may be arrested on an accusation of a non-bailable offense.
punishment: Pre-arrest protection granted upon satisfaction of court conditions.

title: Report of Police Officer on Completion of Investigation (Charge Sheet)
description: Requires police to submit a final report to the Magistrate upon completing investigation within 90 days for serious offences. Informant must also be notified of report status.
punishment: Sets statutory timeline for completing police inquiry and charges.

title: Admissibility of Electronic Records
description: Affirms that any information contained in an electronic record stored in optical, magnetic, or digital media is deemed to be a document and is admissible in court proceedings.
punishment: Governs legal evidentiary value of digital files and communications.

title: Conditions for Admissibility of Electronic Records (Certificate)
description: Lays down mandatory conditions and requirement of a certificate signed by the person in lawful control of the device or expert for producing electronic evidence in court.
punishment: Defective electronic certificate can render digital evidence inadmissible.

title: Burden of Proof
description: The person who desires any court to give judgment as to any legal right or liability dependent on facts asserted must prove that those facts exist.
punishment: Fundamental rule of civil and criminal trial evidence.

title: Deficiency in Service
description: Defines any fault, imperfection, shortcoming, or inadequacy in the quality, nature, and manner of performance required to be maintained by service providers under contracts or law.
punishment: Compensation, refund, and damages awarded by Consumer Commission.

title: Unfair Trade Practice
description: Prohibits adopting unfair methods or deceptive practices like false representation of quality, misleading advertisements, non-issuance of bill/cash memo, and refusing refund of defective goods.
punishment: Injunction, penalty, product recall, and consumer compensation.

title: Manner in which Complaint shall be made to District Commission
description: Outlines how a consumer, registered consumer association, or central authority can file a consumer complaint along with prescribed fees and supporting bills/receipts.
punishment: Direct adjudication and order for refund/compensation within 3 to 5 months.

title: Product Liability of Manufacturer
description: A product manufacturer is liable in a product liability action if the product contains manufacturing defect, design defect, deviation from specifications, or lacks adequate usage warnings.
punishment: Liability for harm, injury, or economic damage caused to the consumer.
